'''November 2001 Indiana tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Indiana in November 2001. It is known from Brian Fred's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3375">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-16-fcon-by-brian-fred-the-way-i-remember-itd3375/ fcon-by-brian-fred-the-way-i-remember-it], DeckTech (john "comando" matrix, 16 February 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-16-fcon-by-brian-fred-the-way-i-remember-itd3375/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' November 2001
* '''Site:''' Indiana
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
